pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Portrait with Sharingan Eyes and a Scratched Leaf Headband Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha appears in a close portrait with Sharingan eyes in this printable coloring page, his steady expression framed by long hair and a scratched Leaf headband. Fine lines beneath his eyes, a beaded necklace, mesh neckline, and tall cloud-patterned Akatsuki collar fill the detailed head-and-shoulders composition.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Wearing an Akatsuki Straw Hat in the Rain Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Itachi Uchiha wearing an Akatsuki straw hat in the rain, lifting one hand to the brim beneath its long hanging strips. Large cloud motifs decorate his open cloak, while falling raindrops, splashes, and rings of water surround the sandals at his feet.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Standing on a Utility Pole Beneath the Full Moon Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha stands on a utility pole beneath the full moon in this printable coloring page, his cloud-patterned cloak and tied-back hair moving gently beside him. The huge textured moon frames his upper body, while scattered clouds, attached wires, pole bands, and open-toed sandals complete the elevated night scene.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Sitting on the Throne in the Uchiha Hideout Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Itachi Uchiha sitting on the throne in the Uchiha hideout, resting one arm on the broad seat with his legs crossed. His cloud-patterned cloak drapes over the cracked stone chair, while Uchiha fan emblems, tall wall panels, floor tiles, and his sandals add setting detail.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Dissolving Into a Flock of Crows Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha dissolves into a flock of crows in this printable coloring page, extending one hand as the edge of his sleeve breaks into feather-like shapes. Three birds spread their wings beside his tall cloud-patterned cloak, with loose feathers, a scratched Leaf headband, and necklace completing the transformation scene.

pages.title: Chibi Itachi Uchiha with a Crow Perched on His Hand Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows chibi Itachi Uchiha with a crow perched on his hand, the small bird gripping his raised finger with delicate claws. His oversized head, scratched Leaf headband, tied-back hair, beaded necklace, cloud-patterned cloak, wrapped lower legs, and sandals create a compact character portrait.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Eating Dango Outside a Hidden Leaf Tea Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha eats dango outside a Hidden Leaf tea shop in this printable coloring page, sitting on a wooden bench with a skewer held near his face. A small cup rests beside him, while the shop's hanging fabric panels, roof beams, fence, bushes, and his cloud-patterned cloak frame the relaxed scene.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Pointing a Finger to Cast Genjutsu Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Itachi Uchiha pointing a finger to cast genjutsu, reaching toward the viewer beneath his focused Sharingan eyes and scratched Leaf headband. A ring decorates the prominently drawn hand, while his tied-back hair, necklace, mesh neckline, and raised cloud-patterned collar complete the close action portrait.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Forming Hand Signs for Fireball Jutsu Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha forms hand signs for Fireball Jutsu in this printable coloring page, holding his fingers together as a large plume of flames streams from his mouth. His tall Akatsuki collar, cloud-patterned cloak, bent knees, wrapped lower legs, and open-toed sandals frame the wide, grounded ninja stance.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Launching Phoenix Flower Jutsu with Shuriken Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Itachi Uchiha launching Phoenix Flower Jutsu with shuriken, extending one hand toward the viewer while holding a two-finger sign beside his chest. Several four-pointed throwing stars trail flame-shaped outlines around his cloud-patterned cloak, with focused eyes, a scratched headband, and necklace adding close character detail.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Using Water Fang Bullet Jutsu Beside the River Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha uses Water Fang Bullet Jutsu beside the river in this printable coloring page, forming a hand sign between two tall curling streams of water. Droplets and splashes rise around his cloud-patterned cloak, while river ripples, scattered rocks, distant shrubs, and his wide-legged stance complete the action scene.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Creating an Exploding Shadow Clone Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Itachi Uchiha creating an exploding shadow clone, standing with a joined hand sign while a second figure breaks into smoke behind him. Rounded smoke puffs obscure the clone's cloud-patterned cloak, with matching headbands, tied-back hair, wrapped lower legs, and sandals clearly linking the two forms.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Activating Amaterasu with His Mangekyou Sharingan Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha activates Amaterasu with his Mangekyou Sharingan in this printable coloring page, standing calmly within tall curling flames that rise around his Akatsuki cloak. His patterned eyes, scratched Leaf headband, necklace, mesh shirt, and open-toed sandals remain visible between the broad cloud motifs and pointed flame shapes.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Casting Tsukuyomi on Kakashi in an Illusion World Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Itachi Uchiha casting Tsukuyomi on Kakashi in an illusion world, the two ninjas facing one another beneath a huge spiral. Itachi's cloud-patterned cloak contrasts with Kakashi's mask and pocketed flak jacket, while winding lines and concentric ground rings fill the otherwise empty surrounding space.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Protected By the Ribcage of His Susanoo Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha is protected by his Susanoo's ribcage in this printable coloring page, holding a hand sign inside the huge curved skeletal frame around him. Repeated ribs, a tall central spine, and flame-shaped chakra outlines rise behind his cloud-patterned cloak, with his grounded stance centered beneath the structure.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Summoning Armored Susanoo with the Totsuka Blade and Yata Mirror Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Itachi Uchiha summoning armored Susanoo with the Totsuka Blade and Yata Mirror, standing before the towering horned guardian with one hand raised. Segmented armor, a flame-edged sword, a gourd-shaped vessel, and a large circular patterned shield fill the detailed protective figure behind him.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Blocking Sasuke's Kirin with Susanoo Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha blocks Sasuke's Kirin with Susanoo in this printable coloring page, standing beneath the armored guardian as a jagged lightning creature descends from above. A tall sword and broad raised shield frame the clash, while angular armor plates, a horned helmet, and curling chakra flames surround Itachi's cloak.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Confronting Orochimaru's Eight-headed Serpent with Susanoo Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Itachi Uchiha confronting Orochimaru's eight-headed serpent with Susanoo, his small figure standing before the enormous sword-and-shield-wielding guardian. Long scaled snake necks rise behind the armor with open fanged mouths, while flame outlines, a horned helmet, and layered protective plates fill the dense action scene.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Launching Yasaka Beads at Chibaku Tensei Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha launches Yasaka Beads at Chibaku Tensei in this printable coloring page, forming a hand sign as Susanoo reaches toward the rocky sphere overhead. Three curved bead shapes streak from the guardian's hand, with floating stone fragments, segmented armor, and curling chakra flames surrounding the upward attack.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Sealing Nagato with the Totsuka Blade Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Itachi Uchiha sealing Nagato with the Totsuka Blade, standing before Susanoo as swirling energy wraps around the suspended cloaked figure. The giant guardian holds a patterned gourd beside the flame-shaped blade, with sweeping spirals, horned armor, and pointed chakra outlines linking the figures.

pages.title: Reanimated Itachi Uchiha Wearing His Edo Tensei Cloak with Cracked Skin Coloring Page
pages.description: Reanimated Itachi Uchiha wears his Edo Tensei cloak in this printable coloring page, standing upright with fine cracks drawn across his cheeks beneath his focused eyes. His plain high-collared robe leaves broad fabric sections, with tied-back hair, loose cropped trousers, and open-toed sandals clearly outlined against the empty background.

pages.title: Reanimated Itachi Uchiha Traveling Beside Nagato Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows reanimated Itachi Uchiha traveling beside Nagato, the two long-cloaked ninjas walking along a narrow forest path with serious expressions. Cracks mark their faces, while Nagato's hair covers one eye and Itachi's tied-back hair falls behind his collar, surrounded by trees, shrubs, rocks, and grass.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Breaking Free of Edo Tensei with Shisui's Crow Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha breaks free of Edo Tensei with Shisui's crow in this printable coloring page, looking toward the flying bird above his raised collar. Fragmented bands peel away around his long plain cloak, while the crow's patterned eye, spread feathers, lowered claws, and Itachi's cracked cheeks emphasize the supernatural scene.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Rescuing Naruto and Killer Bee with Susanoo Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Itachi Uchiha rescuing Naruto and Killer Bee with Susanoo, extending an open palm before the giant skeletal guardian behind him. Naruto crouches at one side while Killer Bee braces on the other, both sheltered among enormous ribs, clawed hands, and tall flame-shaped chakra outlines.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Advising Naruto After the Battle with Nagato Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha advises Naruto after the battle with Nagato in this printable coloring page, gesturing with one open hand while Naruto listens on a forest path. Itachi's long plain cloak contrasts with Naruto's zipped ninja jacket, while tall trunks, leafy canopies, shrubs, scattered rocks, and grass frame the conversation.

pages.title: Young Itachi Uchiha Throwing Shuriken at Forest Targets Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows young Itachi Uchiha throwing shuriken at forest targets, extending one arm as a four-pointed star flies toward the nearest circular board. Another shuriken waits behind his back, while the Uchiha fan emblem, shorts, leg wraps, trees, bushes, and wooden target stands complete the training scene.

pages.title: Young Itachi Uchiha Studying in the Ninja Academy Classroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Young Itachi Uchiha studies in the Ninja Academy classroom in this printable coloring page, sitting at a wooden desk with a pencil above his open workbook. A small Uchiha fan emblem decorates his short-sleeved shirt, with a classroom board, tall window, tiled floor, chair, and wrapped lower legs completing the scene.

pages.title: Genin Itachi Uchiha Catching a Ninja Cat on a Team Two Mission Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features genin Itachi Uchiha catching a ninja cat on a Team Two mission, holding the small collared animal securely in both arms. His Leaf headband, tied-back hair, high-necked shirt, thigh pouch, cropped trousers, leg wraps, and sandals frame the cat's large eyes, whiskers, paws, and curling tail.

pages.title: Young Itachi Uchiha Learning Fireball Jutsu From Fugaku Beside the Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: Young Itachi Uchiha learns Fireball Jutsu from Fugaku beside the lake in this printable coloring page, forming a hand sign as a small fire plume leaves his mouth. Fugaku watches with folded arms behind him, with matching Uchiha emblems, shoreline grass, calm water, distant trees, and mountains framing the lesson.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Wearing His Anbu Mask and Armor Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Itachi Uchiha wearing his Anbu mask and armor, standing with both arms lowered beside his fitted protective vest and forearm guards. The pointed animal mask has narrow eye openings and simple face markings, with a back-mounted sword, thigh pouch, leg wraps, and sandals completing the uniform.

pages.title: Anbu Itachi Uchiha Drawing His Sword on a Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: Anbu Itachi Uchiha draws his sword on a rooftop in this printable coloring page, holding the hilt and sheath before his waist beneath a focused expression. His protective vest, forearm guards, thigh pouch, and sandals stand on curved roof tiles, with village towers, trees, clouds, and a full moon behind him.

pages.title: Anbu Itachi Uchiha Patrolling the Hidden Leaf with Kakashi Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Anbu Itachi Uchiha patrolling the Hidden Leaf with Kakashi, both walking down a village street with animal masks tilted beside their heads. Matching armor, forearm guards, thigh pouches, and back-mounted swords link their outfits, while Kakashi's cloth face mask and spiky hair distinguish him beside Itachi.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Training with Shisui in the Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha trains with Shisui in the forest in this printable coloring page, the two ninjas crouching in wide stances with kunai held across their bodies. Their Leaf headbands, short-sleeved outfits, thigh pouches, wrapped lower legs, and open-toed sandals stand among tall trees, bushes, grass, stones, and scattered ground lines.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Listening to Shisui's Final Request Beside the River Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Itachi Uchiha listening to Shisui's final request beside the river, both sitting on a broad rock and looking toward each other. Shisui wears protective armor and carries a back-mounted sword, while rippling water, a small bridge, trees, stones, and distant hills frame their quiet conversation.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Carrying Young Sasuke on His Back Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha carries young Sasuke on his back in this printable coloring page, walking through the Hidden Leaf Village as his smiling brother holds his shoulders. A Uchiha fan emblem decorates Itachi's shirt, with wrapped legs, sandals, wooden walls, tiled rooftops, trees, and Leaf-marked towers completing the village route.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Poking Young Sasuke's Forehead Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Itachi Uchiha poking young Sasuke's forehead, extending two fingers as the smaller boy smiles with his eyes closed. Both brothers wear plain high-collared shirts, shorts, leg wraps, and open-toed sandals, leaving their expressions and affectionate gesture clear against the empty background.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Teaching Sasuke to Throw Shuriken Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha teaches Sasuke to throw shuriken in this printable coloring page, holding a four-pointed throwing star up while his younger brother watches with another in hand. Matching Uchiha shirt emblems, a circular wooden target, a low fence, bushes, and grass establish the family training ground.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Playing Hide and Seek with Sasuke Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Itachi Uchiha playing hide and seek with Sasuke, covering his eyes against a large tree while the smaller boy peeks around a bush. Their matching Uchiha shirts, shorts, leg wraps, and sandals stand along a grassy forest path beneath leafy branches and dense shrubs.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Holding Baby Sasuke During the Nine-tails Attack Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha holds baby Sasuke during the Nine-tails attack in this printable coloring page, cradling the sleeping infant while taking a braced stance on a village terrace. The fox's enormous fanged head and sweeping tails rise beyond smoke and clustered rooftops, with Itachi's worried expression anchoring the foreground.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Accompanying Sasuke to His Ninja Academy Entrance Ceremony Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Itachi Uchiha accompanying Sasuke to his Ninja Academy entrance ceremony, holding his little brother's hand as they walk through the open gate. Sasuke smiles with one hand on a backpack strap, while paved ground, village buildings, trees, and their matching casual ninja clothes frame the scene.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Facing Sasuke Before Their Battle at the Uchiha Hideout Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha faces Sasuke before their battle at the Uchiha hideout in this printable coloring page, standing opposite his brother beneath a large fan emblem. Itachi's cloud-patterned cloak contrasts with Sasuke's open-collared shirt, rope belt, forearm guards, and sheathed sword, with cracked stone tiles and broad wall panels behind them.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha and Sasuke Fighting Kabuto in His Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Itachi Uchiha and Sasuke fighting Kabuto in his cave, with Itachi forming a hand sign while Sasuke holds his sword ready. Hooded Kabuto crouches opposite them with a long scaled snake tail, surrounded by hanging stalactites, rough cavern walls, scattered stones, and pointed ground formations.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Casting Izanami with Falling Crow Feathers Around Kabuto Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha casts Izanami with falling crow feathers around Kabuto in this printable coloring page, facing the hooded ninja inside a tall rocky cavern. Curved trails carry loose feathers between them, while Kabuto's glasses, rope belt, long snake tail, hanging cave formations, and scattered rocks add distinctive scene details.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha and Kisame Escaping Jiraiya's Toad Trap with Amaterasu Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Itachi Uchiha and Kisame escaping Jiraiya's toad trap with Amaterasu, walking through an opening edged by tall curling flames. Matching cloud-patterned cloaks link the pair, while Kisame's large bandaged sword, shoulder strap, sharp-toothed grin, and the tunnel's rounded textured walls frame their escape route.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Touching Sasuke's Forehead Before Fading Away Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha touches Sasuke's forehead before fading away in this printable coloring page, leaning close until the brothers' foreheads meet as small fragments drift behind him. Itachi's long cloak breaks apart along one side, contrasting with Sasuke's solid outline, open shirt, thick rope belt, forearm guards, and wrapped lower legs.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha and Kisame Arriving at the Hidden Leaf Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Itachi Uchiha and Kisame arriving at the Hidden Leaf Village, walking before the wide-open gates and their large Leaf emblem. Their cloud-patterned cloaks move around their legs, with Itachi's scratched headband, Kisame's wrapped sword and broad strap, village towers, bushes, and cracked paving behind them.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Reversing Kurenai's Tree-binding Genjutsu Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha reverses Kurenai's tree-binding genjutsu in this printable coloring page, standing calmly beside the ninja as leafy branches coil around her arms and torso. Kurenai's surprised expression and wrapped outfit contrast with Itachi's tall cloud-patterned cloak, while river ripples, rocks, shrubs, and grass complete the outdoor illusion scene.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Challenging Deidara During His Akatsuki Recruitment Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Itachi Uchiha challenging Deidara during his Akatsuki recruitment, watching as Deidara holds a small clay bird above his open palm. Deidara's long ponytail, side-swept hair, hand-mouth detail, waist pouch, and sleeveless outfit contrast with Itachi's cloud cloak against a sparse rocky backdrop.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha and Juzo Preparing for a Mission in the Land of Water Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha and Juzo prepare for a mission in the Land of Water in this printable coloring page, standing near the shore in contrasting ninja outfits. Itachi holds his cloud cloak near the collar, while Juzo balances a huge notched sword across one shoulder beside reeds, calm water, and distant land.

pages.title: Itachi Uchiha Joining the Akatsuki as Pain and Orochimaru Welcome Him Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Itachi Uchiha joining the Akatsuki as Pain and Orochimaru welcome him, standing beneath a large cloud emblem in a stone hall. Pain extends one hand while Orochimaru folds his arms, with high collars, Itachi's cloud-patterned cloak, steps, cracked walls, and flame bowls framing the group.

pages.title: Naruto Itachi Pointing in Stone Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha points across a stone village in this printable coloring page, extending one arm from a rocky ledge above the winding street below him. His cloud-patterned cloak and scratched headband stand against steep cliffs, blocky towers, small houses, leafy trees, scattered stones, and layered rock formations.

pages.title: Naruto Itachi Running in Hokage Monument Area Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Itachi Uchiha running in the Hokage Monument area, pumping his arms as his long cloud-patterned cloak opens around his lifted legs. The carved Hokage faces rise behind the village rooftops, with trees, shrubs, cliffs, rocks, grass, and clouds surrounding the winding path beneath him.

pages.title: Naruto Itachi Sitting in Hidden Leaf Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha sits in the Hidden Leaf Village in this printable coloring page, resting cross-legged on a rooftop while wearing a pocketed flak jacket. His forehead protector, necklace, long front hair strands, and sandals fill the foreground, with layered rooftops, leafy trees, distant hills, and carved Hokage faces behind him.

pages.title: Naruto Itachi Running in Village Market Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Naruto and Itachi running through a village market, their bent arms and lifted knees carrying them between wooden shops and striped awnings. Itachi's cloud-patterned cloak trails beside Naruto's zipped jacket, with produce crates, barrels, hanging lanterns, blank signs, and paving stones lining the narrow street.

pages.title: Naruto Itachi Walking in Sandy Desert Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha walks with Naruto through a sandy desert in this printable coloring page, their full-length figures following a shallow track between gently curved dunes. Itachi's cloud cloak contrasts with Naruto's high-collared jacket and thigh straps, while scattered footprints, small stones, distant ridges, and clouds complete the open landscape.

pages.title: Naruto Itachi Jumping in Hokage Monument Area Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Naruto and Itachi jumping in the Hokage Monument area, both lifting bent knees while holding their arms in ready positions. Naruto's headband ties and Itachi's cloud cloak trail through the action, with village roofs, winding streets, trees, rocks, and the great carved faces behind them.

pages.title: Naruto Itachi Waving in Castle Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Itachi Uchiha waves in a castle courtyard in this printable coloring page, raising one hand high while smiling with closed eyes above his cloud-patterned cloak. Broad paving slabs lead toward a traditional tiled building, with wooden doors, steps, clipped trees, a stone base, and a simple gateway framing the cheerful pose.

pages.title: Naruto Itachi Standing on Mountain Trail Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Itachi Uchiha standing on a mountain trail, holding one hand near the opening of his long cloud-patterned cloak. A narrow path winds up the rocky slopes behind him, with jagged cliffs, distant peaks, scattered stones, shrubs, grass, and a few clouds filling the open landscape.

pages.title: Naruto Itachi Waving in Spirit Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Naruto and Itachi wave in a spirit forest in this printable coloring page, standing side by side with raised hands and cheerful expressions beneath the leafy canopy. Naruto's high-collared jacket contrasts with Itachi's cloud cloak, while falling leaves, winding paths, broad plants, shrubs, and tall trunks surround the pair.

pages.title: Naruto Itachi Standing in Thunderstorm Valley Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Itachi Uchiha standing in a thunderstorm valley, his cloud-patterned cloak hanging beside his lowered hands as rain falls around him. Jagged lightning bolts split the heavy clouds overhead, while steep mountain walls, scattered rocks, broken ground, and a raised stone ledge complete the stormy scene.
